Services PMI® at 55.4%

August 2026 ISM® Services PMI® Report

In August, the Services PMI® registered 55.4 percent, an increase of 1.3 percentage points compared to July’s figure of 54.1 percent.

The Prices Index registered above 70 percent; the reading of 72.6 percent in August is 2.3 percentage points above July’s figure of 70.3 percent.

The next ISM® Services PMI® Report featuring September 2026 data will be released at 10:00 a.m. ET on Monday, October 5, 2026.
